template: Open {{v1}} in the browser. If the login page appears, sign in with username 'admin' and password 'admin'; if Grafana then asks you to change your password, click 'Skip'. Once signed in, find the provisioned dashboard named '{{v2}}' (use the Dashboards / search page), open it, and report the exact titles of all panels shown on the dashboard, exactly as displayed, one per line.

Once signed in, find the provisioned dashboard named 'Service health' (use the Dashboards / search page), open it, and report the exact titles of all panels shown on the dashboard, exactly as displayed, one per line.
